title: Toggle Rounded Corners (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Toggle Rounded Corners applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Toggle Rounded Corners (BtnSmartCorners) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Toggle Rounded Corners flips the real AutoShapeType back and forth in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Toggle Rounded Corners on one selected native rectangle flips its AutoShapeType to msoShapeRoundedRectangle (measured roundedBefore=False roundedAfterFirst=True), a second invocation flips it back (roundedAfterSecond=False), both invocations return true, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
